conviction_note: The event is real but it falls AFTER the sealed window. The board meets on 9 Nov and PharmaNutra has released every recent set of results after the close (17:40-18:38 CET), so the reaction falls in close 11-09 to close 11-10. The 9M/Q3 numbers are new and this thin name has moved 6-14% on each of its last five results, so abs_move is 8.5. Direction is near a coin flip (p_up 53). An easier Q3 margin comparison under a company guide for margin recovery (+1.0) is offset by a tough Q3 2025 foreign-revenue comparison (-1.0). The finding sum (+0.2) and the scaled number (+0.51) agree in sign and are both small, which is the honest read.

already_public.what: H1 2026: sales EUR 73.0m (+17.9%), EBITDA EUR 17.5m (+6.2%, margin 23.5% vs 26.1%). Implied Q2: sales ~40.3m (+13.5%), EBITDA ~11.3m vs 11.6m (margin ~27.6% vs ~31.9%). Stock -7.74% on 2026-09-14.

H2 outlook: a further substantial rise in revenue led by foreign markets and the new BUs, with margin on revenue improving and expected in line with the prior year (FY2025 EBITDA margin 25.5%; H2 2025 ~25%).
Buyback launch release restates that the outlook for revenue and margin is 'extremely positive' for the end of the year; cap of 20,000 shares / EUR 1.44m.
FY2025 release: the US subsidiary is expected to reach operating breakeven during Q4 2026; margins to rise progressively.
Intermonte BUY, TP raised 98 to 102 after H1, 2026-28 revenue estimates +3-4%, margin assumptions unchanged; Berenberg BUY 93, TP ICAP BUY 92.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 sales and EBITDA are new (no pre-release). Comparison: Q3 2025 sales ~32.7m (+19%), EBITDA ~8.3m (~25.5%). Revenue growth probably decelerates from H1's 17.9% on a tough foreign comparison; the margin comparison is far easier than Q2's. Direction unknown, leaning flat.
Qualitative outlook restated. A downgrade of the H2 margin language would be the big negative; a confirmation of the US Q4 breakeven is the likely positive. No numeric guide is expected.

Net financial position at 30 Sep (was -2.9m at 30 Jun after an 11.5m dividend). Probably back near or above zero on seasonal cash generation (9M 2025 went from -5.1m to +2.3m in Q3). Mild positive, largely expected.

bar: No numeric consensus is sourced (Yahoo empty, broker notes paywalled). The bar used is the company's own H2 guide: margin in line with the prior year (~25%) and a further substantial revenue increase (https://pharmanutragroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/CS-H1-2026-PHN-110926-ITA.pdf), plus Intermonte's ~+18% FY26 revenue growth raised 3-4% (https://www.teleborsa.it/News/2026/05/12/pharmanutra-intermonte-alza-il-prezzo-obiettivo-a-98-euro-e-ribadisce-il-buy-159.html, https://www.borsainside.com/mercati_italiani/azioni-pharmanutra-intermonte-e-bullish-dopo-la-semestrale/). Treated as unsourced numerically, so every finding is capped small.

findings.finding: The Q3 margin comparison is much easier than Q2's, and it sits under a company guide for margin recovery. Q3 2025 EBITDA margin was ~25.5% (EUR 8.3m on ~32.6m) against ~31.9% for Q2 2025. The company guided H2 2026 margin 'in linea con quella dell'esercizio precedente' (~25%), restated 'estremamente positive' prospects on 16 Sep, and expects the US subsidiary at breakeven during Q4 2026. So the line that cost the stock 7.7% after H1 (margin) should screen better at 9M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin is what this stock trades on. H1 2026: sales +17.9% but margin 23.5% vs 26.1%, stock -7.74% (2026-09-14). Q1 2026: margin held with sales +24%, +13.7% (2026-05-12). 9M 2025: margin 'only slightly' diluted and the company stressed underlying 32%, +14.2% (2025-11-11).
findings.original_quote: Nel secondo semestre si prevede un ulteriore consistente incremento dei ricavi trainato sia dal business ricorrente, in particolare dai ricavi dei mercati esteri, che dalle nuove Business Unit, con un miglioramento della marginalità sui ricavi, che si prevede in linea con quella dell'esercizio precedente. [In H2 a further substantial revenue increase is expected, driven by both the recurring business, especially foreign markets, and the new Business Units, with margin on revenue improving and expected to be in line with the prior year.]
findings.why_not_priced: The stock is at 73.5, still below the 78.8 close before H1 and -11.45% over 60 days, while the brokers' TPs sit at 92-102. If the market were carrying the guided H2 margin recovery, the H1 sell-off would have retraced. Instead the price sits flat on the post-H1 level, consistent with a market that has not believed the margin language. The comparison arithmetic (Q3 2025 25.5% vs Q2 2025 31.9%) is in no wire copy. This lands inside what the company guided, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The US Q4-2026 breakeven guide is a separate document (https://pharmanutragroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/CS-PHARMANUTRA-FY2025-RESULTS-ITA.pdf), and Intermonte left margin assumptions unchanged after H1 (https://www.borsainside.com/mercati_italiani/azioni-pharmanutra-intermonte-e-bullish-dopo-la-semestrale/). Both are company or broker restatements rather than independent data.

findings.finding: Q3 faces a tough foreign-revenue comparison, and the H1 2026 release dropped the order-book line the H1 2025 release carried. Q3 2025 foreign sales were ~EUR 12.4m (9M 33.3m less H1 20.9m) against ~9.4m in Q3 2024, about +32%, and total Q3 2025 sales grew ~19%. The company says foreign revenue swings with 'dinamiche temporali di acquisizione degli ordini da parte dei distributori'. H1 2025 stated that orders for all of Q3 and Q4 were already in hand; H1 2026 says nothing of the kind. Headline revenue growth risks decelerating from 17.9% toward ~10%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue acceleration was rewarded: Q1 2026 +24% sales, +13.7%; 9M 2025 'significativa crescita del terzo trimestre' abroad, +14.2%. Revenue strength without margin was sold (H1 2026, -7.7%). A revenue deceleration has not been tested in this window.
findings.original_quote: Grazie alla significativa crescita del terzo trimestre, i ricavi derivanti dalle vendite sui mercati esteri ammontano a Euro 33,3 milioni, con un incremento del 19% circa rispetto al 30 settembre 2024 (Euro 28,0 milioni) [Thanks to significant third-quarter growth, foreign sales reached EUR 33.3m, up about 19% on 30 Sep 2024 (EUR 28.0m)]; H1 2025 (https://pharmanutragroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/CS_PHN_risultati-H1_2025-8.9.25_def.pdf): 'Alla data attuale, il Gruppo, inoltre, ha già in portafoglio gli ordini relativi a tutto il terzo e quarto trimestre.' [The Group already holds the orders for all of Q3 and Q4]
findings.why_not_priced: Brokers raised revenue estimates 3-4% after H1 (Intermonte) and the company guides 'ulteriore consistente incremento'. If the market were braced for a revenue slowdown, the sell-side revenue upgrade would not be the latest move and the stock would not sit 30-40% below every TP. The quarterly comparison has to be derived by subtracting H1 from 9M across two documents; no wire carries it. This is an inference from the comparison, not a company number, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The H1 2026 release itself attributes foreign swings to distributor order timing (https://pharmanutragroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/CS-H1-2026-PHN-110926-ITA.pdf). That document is the company's own, not an independent series.

findings.finding: Four new Sucrosomial products (Apportal Master, Apportal Junior, Sucrosomial Creatine, Pre Start Shot) were available in Italy from 24 Sep 2026, so late-September pharmacy sell-in falls in Q3. The PiLeje France/Switzerland launch was also slated for September. Launch marketing costs offset part of the gain.

rejected_candidates.detail: 11,000 of the 20,000-share cap were bought by 30 Sep at 1,000 a day. At that pace the cap was reached around mid-October, well before the 11-09/11-10 window, so no buying is expected inside it. This is an inference from the pace; the October 3F is not yet filed.

baseline_tension: The lean (-0.17) and the run-up (+3.4% over 20 days, +3.5% over 5) are nearly flat, and the 60-day run-up (-11.45%) shows the post-H1 drawdown not yet recovered. The findings net to slightly positive, so they mildly cut against the faint negative lean, but nothing found is strong enough to beat it with conviction.
language_note: Every load-bearing document was in Italian: the issuer's Calendario Eventi with the 9 Nov board date, the H1 2026 and 9M 2025 comunicati with the regional splits that make the Q3 comparison computable, and the H2 margin guide wording.
The eMarket STORAGE timestamps (17:40, 18:38, 17:41) that settle the session as amc came only from the Italian regulated storage.
The Allegato 3F buyback report (1,000 shares a day, 11,000 by 30 Sep) exists only on the issuer's Italian IR site and eMarket STORAGE.
The H1 2025 line on holding all Q3/Q4 orders, absent in H1 2026, is in the Italian release only.
The English sources carried nothing beyond aggregator summaries and the Berenberg TP headline (via a French wire).
lessons_applied: The margin-recovery finding lands inside what the company guided, so it moved from +1.5 to +1.0 and p_up from 54 to 53.
The foreign-comparison finding is an inference from comparisons, not a company number (proxy rule), so it moved from -1.2 to -1.0.
The product-launch finding is a proxy, so it moved from +0.3 to +0.2.

Understatement and 'the reaction history moves p_up, not abs_move' (ABC arbitrage): abs_move rose from 8.0 to 8.5, given the period is not pre-released, turnover is thin ($0.7m a day) and the last five results reactions ran 6.4-14.2%.
Session lesson (Adocia/Philogen/VIGO): session_check opens with amc and cites the eMarket STORAGE timestamps.
Truncated-zero lesson: positioning_check states there is no positioning anchor rather than 'nobody is short'.
